title: trace.linked event data
description: One typed link of the trace chain (Phase 2 section 9.2): source, relation, target. Trace links are the single source of truth for the chain; records never hold link lists. Relations recorded in milestone 3: verified_by (AC to TC), mitigated_by (RSK to TC), automated_by (TC to a test id), executed_in and red_check (TC to EXE), violates (FND to AC or REQ). The rest of the chain's relations are named here so later events need no new vocabulary. A test id is the id results record, classname::name, for example tests.test_discount::test_cap. via says how the link came to be: manual (a person or agent named it), tag (a TC-nnn tag in a test name or marker) or map (.qa/trace/test-map.json). It is absent on links recorded before it existed. source and target carry no pattern because a target may be a test id.
